name: llm-wiki
description: Turn an archive of documents into a cited, versioned wiki maintained by Codex and ChatGPT Work.

interface.shortDescription: Build a cited wiki from an archive of documents.
interface.longDescription: Ingest documents into an immutable archive, preserve complete extracted text, and maintain a compact, cited wiki that Codex and ChatGPT Work can query. Supports targeted answers and auditable full-corpus context passes.
defaultPrompt: Answer with full context from the archive
